The '''Jomark system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that contained a medium-sized [[Star/Legends|star]] orbited by six [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. Of the planets in the Jomark system, only [[Jomark/Legends|the second one]], which bore the same name as the system, was capable of supporting life as well as being the only one that hosted a colony.
